inspect.solid: Solid rock. Mine it to dig.
trait.iron_stomach.desc: Eats raw and rotten food without complaint.
trait.rad_hardened.desc: Takes half the radiation dose. Glows a little anyway.
trait.optimist.desc: The glass is half full. Of what, nobody asks.
trait.pessimist.desc: Saw the end of the world coming. Still unimpressed.
trait.night_owl.desc: Sleeps by day, works by night.
trait.tinkerer.desc: Good with machines. Sometimes too good.
trait.lucky_idiot.desc: Bad at almost everything. Survives anyway.
trait.old_worlder.desc: Remembers the world before. Knows tech. Sad about it.
trait.fast_walker.desc: Walks 20% faster. Always first to the loot.
trait.slowpoke.desc: Walks slower. Says the wasteland is not a race.
trait.insomniac.desc: Needs less sleep. Grumpy about it.
trait.tough.desc: Feels 40% less pain. Keeps fighting longer.
trait.wimp.desc: Feels 50% more pain. Goes down early.
trait.sharpshooter.desc: Shooting +4. Used to hunt rats for money.
trait.brawler.desc: Melee +4, shooting -2. Prefers to settle things up close.
trait.camp_cook.desc: Cooking +4. Can make beans taste like more beans.
trait.builder.desc: Construction +4. Walls are a love language.
trait.cheerful.desc: Mood +3, and others like them faster.
trait.abrasive.desc: Says what everyone thinks. Others like them slower.
trait.loner.desc: Mood +2. Slow to make friends, and fine with that.
backstory.suburb_kid.desc: Grew up with lawns, malls and a car in every drive.
backstory.farm_child.desc: Fed chickens before school. Still wakes at dawn.
backstory.gearhead_teen.desc: Took the toaster apart. Then the car.
backstory.rich_heir.desc: Never carried a bag in their life. Still does not.
backstory.bunker_born.desc: Born underground after the sirens. Saw the sky at ten.
backstory.street_runner.desc: Grew up on the corner, fast and hungry.
backstory.scout_kid.desc: Badges for knots, fires and first aid.
backstory.choir_child.desc: Sang in church. Can calm a room with one song.
backstory.army_brat.desc: Moved base to base. Learned to shoot before to swim.
backstory.bookworm.desc: Read everything. Can quote any manual.
backstory.raised_by_rats.desc: Ate from the bins. Can find a meal in any bin.
backstory.hunters_kid.desc: Shot deer with grandpa. Now shoots worse things.
backstory.wasteland_trader.desc: Sold water to the thirsty and bullets to the angry.
backstory.caravan_guard.desc: Walked the long roads with a rifle and a bad back.
backstory.scrap_smith.desc: Beat junk into tools in a burned-out garage.
backstory.vault_tech.desc: Kept the old machines alive. Talks to machines more than people.
backstory.field_surgeon.desc: Patched raiders and saints, no questions asked.
backstory.raider_turned.desc: Rode with a gang. Will not stitch the people they hurt.
backstory.mushroom_farmer.desc: Grew food in the dark under the ruins.
backstory.cult_preacher.desc: Preached the Glow. Thinks digging angers it.
backstory.junk_diver.desc: Dug through collapsed malls for a living.
backstory.water_warden.desc: Ran a town's pumps until the town ran out.
backstory.drifter.desc: Went where the wind went. Good at a little of everything.
backstory.rad_cook.desc: Ran a stew stand by the crater. Knows forty ways to cook a rat.
thought.has_rival: Has to live with a rival
msg.released: {name} was set free and walks away.
prison.ready: Ready to be asked to join
rel.title: Relations
backstory.title: Backstory
scen.standard.desc: Three survivors, a few cans, a ruined town.
scen.lone.desc: One survivor. A hard start, and a lot of quiet.
scen.mall.desc: Start in a ruined supermarket. Lots of loot. Lots of rats.
scen.bunker.desc: Start in the cave under the stairs. The surface glows for two days.
scen.rad_season.desc: Radiation clouds every few days, all year. Build sealed rooms fast.
msg.scenario.lone: You are alone. The wasteland is very quiet.
msg.scenario.mall: You wake up in an old supermarket. Something scratches behind the shelves.
msg.scenario.bunker: The cloud came early. You are in the cave under the stairs. Stay down for two days.
msg.scenario.rad_season: Rad season: the clouds will come again and again.
line.sandbox.desc: No story. Build, survive, automate. Play as long as you like.
line.reactor.desc: A maintenance robot wants you to restart the old reactor. A cult wants it to melt down.
line.bus.desc: A radio ad promises Haven Valley. Restore a school bus and drive everyone there.
line.orbit.desc: Voices on an old radio at night. A station in orbit answers, for a price.
story.reactor.badge.start: A rusty robot rolls in: "HAL-PH, reactor maintenance. SAFETY IS EVERYONE'S JOB." It shows you the way to the old power plant.
story.reactor.badge.done: HAL-PH: "Plant status: dead. Morale status: excellent." The plant had a manual and one good part.
story.reactor.parts.start: HAL-PH lists the missing parts. Two more lie at the cooling tower and the switchyard. The Children of the Glow want them too.
story.reactor.parts.done: Three parts. HAL-PH: "CONGRATULATIONS ON 0 DAYS WITHOUT AN INCIDENT."
story.reactor.console.start: The Glow Cult heard about the parts. They are coming to take them.
story.reactor.console.done: The console hums. HAL-PH salutes it.
story.reactor.restart.start: Load the parts into the console and start the reactor (bill at the console).
story.reactor.restart.done: The reactor wakes up. Every lamp for miles flickers. The cult saw it too.
story.reactor.hold.start: The Children of the Glow attack in force. Hold for two days and clear them out.
story.bus.ad.start: The radio loops an ad: "Haven Valley! Clean air! Low rent! Children ride free!" A bus depot lies nearby.
story.bus.ad.done: At the depot: an old school bus and its repair manual. The horn still works. It plays one song.
story.bus.restore.start: Research vehicle repair and rebuild the school bus at home.
story.bus.restore.done: The bus starts on the third try. Everyone cheers. Someone cries.
story.bus.upgrades.start: The bus needs armor and a better engine. Try the armory and the truck stop.
story.bus.upgrades.done: The bus is a land fortress now. It still plays the one song.
story.bus.supplies.start: Load food and water for the trip: 40 cans and 40 jugs of clean water.
story.bus.supplies.done: Packed. The map shows Haven Valley at the edge of the world.
story.bus.journey.start: Send a team to Haven Valley to see if it is real.
story.orbit.voices.start: At night a survivor hears voices on an old radio. Everyone says they are crazy. Research radio tech to listen better.
story.orbit.voices.done: The voices are real: a space station, still up there. They need relays to hear you.
story.orbit.relays.start: Three old relay towers stand in the wasteland. Found an outpost at each to hold them.
story.orbit.relays.done: All three relays are yours. The station hears a faint signal.
story.orbit.dish.start: Research the dish and build it at home.
story.orbit.dish.done: The dish turns to the sky. The station answers: "We can help. But we need medicine and electronics first."
story.orbit.bargain.start: Gather 20 bandages and 10 electronics for the station.
story.orbit.bargain.done: The supplies go up on a rocket nobody knew they had. The station sends back plans.
story.orbit.broadcast.start: Send the final signal with the relay codes (bill at the dish).
msg.story_site: New story location on the world map: {site}.
research.reactor_control.desc: Build the reactor console. Needs the reactor manual.
research.vehicle_repair.desc: Rebuild the school bus. Needs the bus repair manual.
research.dish_design.desc: A big dish that can talk to orbit.
ending.won.reactor.text: The reactor hums. The region lights up for the first time in years. HAL-PH files a safety report nobody reads.
ending.won.bus.text: Haven Valley is real. The air is almost clean. The rent is not low, but the bus is paid for.
ending.won.orbit.text: The station answers, and keeps answering. Some of you will go up one day. The rest have a radio that never sleeps.
ending.lost.title: The wasteland keeps score
ending.lost.text: Nobody is left to tell the story. Here is what we know.
ending.dead: Died on day {day} ({cause}). Remembered, mostly fondly.
ending.quiet: {name} kept their head down and lived. In the wasteland, that is a talent.
ending.kills: {name} put down {n} enemies. Nobody argues with {name} about chores anymore.
ending.rescues: {name} carried the wounded to safety {n} times. Several people owe {name} their legs.
ending.built: {name} built {n} things. Half the base still has their initials scratched into it.
ending.crafted: {name} made {n} things at the benches. Some of them even work.
ending.trait.iron_stomach: {name} ate things nobody else would. They are still fine. Probably.
ending.trait.rad_hardened: {name} glows a little at night. Useful during blackouts.
ending.trait.optimist: {name} smiled through all of it. It was annoying, and it helped.
ending.trait.pessimist: {name} said it would end badly. It did not, and they are suspicious.
ending.trait.hard_worker: {name} never stopped working. They still have not.
ending.trait.night_owl: {name} kept watch every night. The owls respect them.
ending.trait.tinkerer: {name} took apart every machine once. Most went back together.
ending.trait.lucky_idiot: {name} survived on luck alone. The luck is tired.
ending.trait.old_worlder: {name} still tells stories about the internet. Nobody believes them.
ending.trait.fast_walker: {name} was always first to the loot and first to run.
ending.trait.big_eater: {name} ate a third of all the beans. Worth it.
ending.trait.small_appetite: {name} lived on crumbs and quiet pride.
ending.trait.camel: {name} barely drank. Water rations loved them.
ending.trait.sleepyhead: {name} slept through two raids. Both times it worked out.
ending.trait.insomniac: {name} did not sleep. They know everyone's secrets now.
ending.trait.tough: {name} took every hit and kept going.
ending.trait.wimp: {name} fainted at the sight of blood, then got up and helped anyway.
ending.trait.brawler: {name} solved problems up close. The problems stayed solved.
ending.trait.green_thumb: {name} grew food in dust. The glowcorn misses them.
ending.trait.camp_cook: {name} made beans taste like better beans.
ending.trait.field_medic: {name} stitched everyone up at least once.
ending.trait.scrap_rat: {name} found treasure in every junk pile.
ending.trait.builder: {name} built walls. Good walls. Walls with feelings.
ending.trait.cheerful: {name} kept everyone sane with bad jokes.
ending.trait.abrasive: {name} said what everyone thought. Out loud. Every time.
ending.trait.kind: {name} was kind when nobody else could be.
ending.trait.loner: {name} kept to themselves, and kept everyone alive.
thought.ate_canned: Ate cold beans from a can
thought.survived_the_end: Survived the end of the world
msg.break_sulk: {name} has had enough of everything and is sulking.
order.salvage.desc: Take apart ruins, wrecks and junk for scrap and loot. Your own buildings stay safe.
order.deconstruct.desc: Take down your own buildings. Gives back 75% of the materials.
order.mine.desc: Dig out rock, coal and buried junk.
order.clear.desc: Clear rubble for a bit of scrap and stone.
order.cut.desc: Cut dead trees and shrubs for wood.
stockpile.title: This stockpile takes
tool.hint: Drag to place. Right click or Esc to stop.
work.title: Work priorities
work.hint: 1 = do first, 4 = do last, – = never. Small number = skill.
msg.need_material: Plans wait for {item}, and the colony has none. Salvage wrecks and junk (Orders) to get more.
inspect.shelter_open: No roof here yet. Survivors build it (construction work).
inspect.shelter_leaky: Roofed. A door opens to outside: food and water have a small chance to glow after a cloud. Add a second door for an airlock.
inspect.shelter_sealed: Sealed: roof and airlock. Clouds and toxic rain cannot get in.
weather.rad_banner: Radiation cloud! Stay under a roof. Food and water outside may glow for a season. Rooms with an airlock (two doors) stay clean.
weather.rad_warning: Radiation cloud in {hours} h. Move food and water under a roof.
msg.rad_warning: The Geiger counter is getting chatty. Radiation cloud in about {hours} hours.
msg.rad_cloud_start: The radiation cloud is here. Everyone inside!
msg.rad_contamination: The cloud is gone. {crops} crops and {stacks} stacks of food and water are contaminated for a season.
msg.toxic_rain_start: Toxic rain. It stings, it glows a little, and it gets into anything left outside.
msg.toxic_contamination: The toxic rain stopped. {crops} crops and {stacks} stacks of food and water are contaminated for half a season.
thing.glowcorn_plant.desc: Fast, low yield. Likes warmth. Glows a bit, harmlessly. Mostly.
thing.scrub_potato_plant.desc: Slow, but grows even in the cold.
thing.fiber_weed_plant.desc: Gives cloth for beds and bandages.
bills.title: Keep in stock
bills.hint: Survivors work here until the stock reaches the target.
pawn.draft_hint: Tap an enemy to attack. Tap the ground to move. Right click works too.
part.head: Head
msg.died: {name} died of {cause}. The wasteland keeps score.
msg.lost_limb: {name} lost the {part}. Still has the other one.
msg.raid: Raiders! {n} of them, and they did not come to trade.
msg.rad_rats: A swarm of {n} rad-rats smells your food.
msg.glow_hounds: {n} glow-hounds howl in the dark. They are hungry.
msg.raid_won: Nobody is standing. The raiders take what they can carry and will leave soon.
msg.rad_rats_won: Nobody is standing. The rats will lose interest soon.
msg.glow_hounds_won: Nobody is standing. The hounds will slink off soon.
msg.wanderer: {name} walks in from the wasteland and asks to stay. Nobody says no.
msg.cargo: Something fell from the sky: {count} × {item}. Finders keepers.
world.title: World map
world.story_site: A story location. Something important waits here.
world.pick_site: Pick a site on the map. Home is the pale square.
world.problem.not_free: Someone in the team is hurt, drafted or not at home.
world.problem.no_food: Not enough clean food in stores for the trip.
world.problem.no_water: Not enough clean water in stores for the trip.
world.problem.no_outpost_materials: Not enough materials for an outpost.
site.ruins.desc: Collapsed houses. Scrap, cloth and old cans.
site.bunker.desc: Sealed rooms with steel, parts and electronics. Often guarded.
site.wreck_field.desc: Rows of dead cars. Lots of scrap.
site.dead_town.desc: Shops and homes. Food, water and cloth.
site.crater_rim.desc: Where the bomb fell. Steel and electronics, and danger.
msg.expedition_ambush: The team at the {site} was ambushed!
msg.outpost_founded: An outpost now stands at the {site}.
fac.rust_knights.desc: Raiders in welded armor. Guns, big raids, no mercy.
fac.glow_cult.desc: Pray to the crater. Fight with blades. Shrug off radiation.
fac.water_union.desc: Well keepers who trade water, food and medicine.
fac.scrap_nomads.desc: Junk traders on the old roads. Metal, parts, sometimes guns.
msg.caravan: A {faction} caravan is here. They stay about a day.
msg.gift: The {faction} thank you for the gift.
trade.title: Trade: {faction}
trade.total: You give {give} value for {get} value (they want {need})
trade.problem.missing_items: You do not have those items any more.
trade.problem.trader_short: They do not have that many.
research.title: Research
research.hint: Pick a project. Survivors with Research work study at a desk.
research.hint_busy: Survivors with Research work study at a desk. Pick another project to switch.
research.scrap_power.desc: Wood-fired generators and wires. Light at last.
research.electric_lights.desc: Lamps. Raiders hate them. Mutants too.
research.powered_tools.desc: A powered workbench works much faster.
research.smelting.desc: Turn scrap and coal into steel.
research.turret_wiring.desc: A scrap turret that shoots on its own, while it has power.
research.gunsmithing.desc: Pipe pistols and crossbows at the workbench.
research.rain_catchers.desc: Collect clean water from the rain.
research.conveyors.desc: Belts and loaders move items without hands.
research.plumbing.desc: Pipes, pumps, tanks and taps bring water into the base.
research.water_purification.desc: A purifier makes clean water from dirty water.
research.biofuel.desc: A still turns raw food into fuel. Generators next to its pipes fill up by themselves.
research.power_grid.desc: Power poles reach 6 tiles, switches cut lines, and machines get priorities for blackouts.
research.renewables.desc: Solar panels and wind turbines make power without fuel.
research.deep_digging.desc: Dig stairs further down. Something old is buried under the caves.
research.plastics.desc: A refinery makes plastic from fuel. Needs the plastics manual.
research.electronics.desc: Circuit boards from components and plastic. Needs the electronics manual.
research.assembling.desc: The assembler: a fast auto-crafter. Needs the assembler schematic.
research.robotics.desc: A robot bay builds robots and hauler drones, and charges and repairs them.
research.belt_logistics.desc: Splitters, sorters, underground belts and robot arms.
research.auto_crafting.desc: A machine that runs a recipe by itself. Needs the factory manual.
msg.robot_built: A new {kind} rolls out of the bay: {name}.
msg.robot_low: {name} is out of charge. Build or power a robot bay.
msg.blackout: Not enough power. Machines turned off: {n}. Low-priority machines go off first.
inspect.fluids: Pipe network: {water} L water, {clean} L clean water, {fuel} L fuel, {room} L free
inspect.pump_dry: No water next to the pump.
inspect.net: Network: {produce} W made, {use} W used, {stored} Wh stored
crafter.title: Recipe
filter.title: Item filter
chest.title: Contents
bench.sides: Input side: {in} · Output side: {out} (belts, arms, chests)
title.eyebrow: A colony sim at the end of the world
title.name: Ash & Gears
title.tagline: Three survivors. One ruined town. The machines can wait. Dinner cannot.
newgame.title: New game
story.grandma.desc: Calm. Long quiet spells for building.
story.sheriff.desc: Classic. Rising trouble, then a breather.
menu.title: Menu
settings.px_hybrid: Hybrid (crisp world, smooth items and people)
goal.title: Goals
hint.shelter.walls: Next: Build › Scrap wall, then drag a box around open ground (4×4 inside is enough).
hint.shelter.close: Next: close every gap. Put a door in one wall (Build › Scrap door).
hint.shelter.roof: Next: survivors are putting the roof on. Check that someone has Construct work.
hint.shelter.bed: Next: Build › Bedroll inside the room. A bedroll needs cloth.
hint.water: Next: Build › Well near home. It needs wood and stone; salvage or mine for stone.
hint.raid.early: Raids start after day 10. Build sandbags by your door, then research a turret.
hint.raid: When raiders come, press Draft all and fight from behind cover.
hint.lights.research: Next: build a research desk, then research Scrap power and Electric lights.
hint.lights.generator: Next: Build › Scrap generator. Survivors fuel it with wood.
hint.lights.wire: Next: connect a lamp to the generator with wires.
goal.shelter: Build shelter: a bed in a closed room
goal.water: Find clean water: build a well or a rain collector
goal.lights: Turn the lights on: a powered lamp
goal.shelter.done: Goal done: shelter. Four walls, a roof, a bed. Luxury.
goal.water.done: Goal done: clean water. It only tastes a little of metal.
goal.raid.done: Goal done: you survived a raid. They will be back.
goal.lights.done: Goal done: the lights are on. For the first time in years.
goal.all_done: All goals done. The wasteland is yours to lose. Keep playing!
msg.intro: Three survivors climb out of the rubble. There are cans, a little water, and nobody else. Build a shelter before night.
msg.showcase: Showcase colony: a few weeks of work, done for you. Look around, then start a real game from the menu.
research.advanced_robotics.desc: The robot bay builds specialist robots: builder, miner, farmer and guard.
msg.robot_hacked: Raiders hacked {name}! It fights for them now. Knock it down or wait: the hack wears off in 12 hours.
msg.robot_unhacked: {name} shook off the hack and is back with the colony.
mods.title: Mods
mods.hint: A mod is a .json content pack. Later mods in the list win when two change the same thing.
mods.restart: Changes take effect with the next new game or load.
inspect.fire_out: The fire is out. A hauler brings wood.
res.loose: {n} more lying around, not in a stockpile yet
thing.card_table.desc: Two survivors play cards here. Good fun.
thing.horseshoe_pit.desc: Throw horseshoes at a stake. Two can play.
sched.title: Schedule
sched.hint: Pick a slot type, then click or drag over the hours. Sleep: go to bed. Work: no free time unless miserable. Recreation: relax until fun is full. Anything: free choice.
alert.no_prison_bed: {name} is marked for capture, but no free bed is set for prisoners. Select a bed and mark it for prisoners.
